title: Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya
body:
Saqqa E Sakina (s.a) Ahle Haram Ki Aas... (2)
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Yeh Bibiyon Se Shahe Karbala Ne Farmaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Sakina (s.a) Paani Ki Umeed Ab Nahi Rakhna.. (2),
Ke Asra Tera Dariya Pe Hi Mai Chord Aaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Madad Ko Aaiye Aaqa Sada E Ghazi (a.s) Hai.. (2),
Hussain (a.s) Boley Mera Lut Gaya Hai Sarmaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Yahi Toh Hausla Mera Yahi Toh Dhaaras Tha.. (2),
Qamar Ko Tod Diya Meri Sheh Ne Farmaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Ehad Ka Paas Rakha Aur Kata Diye Bazu.. (2),
Wafa Shanaas Ne Waada Nibha Ke Dikhlaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Macha Hai Khaymo Me Kohraam Har Taraf Yeh Hi.. (2),
Alam Toh Aagaya Ghazi (a.s) Magar Nahi Aaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Sahara Teri Rida Ka Raha Na Duniya Mein.. (2),
Kisne Jaake Yeh Zainab (s.a) Ko Bhi Batlaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Chiddi Jo Mashke Sakina Labbey Abbas (a.s) Pe Tha.. (2),
Mai Sharmsaar Hoon Bibi Yeh Aab Na Laya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (2)
Majaal Kya Hai ALI DEEP Ki Jo Yeh Likkhey.. (2),
Karam Hai Ghazi (a.s) Ka Isne Kalam Likhwaya...
Alam Toh Aaya Alamdar Aa Nahi Paya... (3).
